_comment: scc site overlay (decision 0050 step 8): path overrides merged over cases.json per case when SITE=scc. Geometry is identical to cases.json and not repeated. bp_dir is empty on purpose: scc has only the official netCDF wrfinput/wrfbdy, so strict_campaign.sbatch links those from prep_dir and exports WTUNE_INPUT_FORMAT=netcdf (configs.py then writes io_form_input/boundary=2; history/restart stay ADIOS2). Thompson/aux input_files at the maria1km/isc21 paths are not yet verified on scc. Cases other than conus25/maria1km/isc21/lafe were relayed from f1 (2026-09-22, ssh tar stream: wrfinput_d0N, wrfbdy_d01, namelist, *.txt/*.dat/*.TBL) into $HOME/wrf-cases/<case>/ with flat file names.

climate-ea50.notes: scc-only (not in cases.json): 13-month East-Asia 50 km regional climate run 2022-12-01 -> 2024-01-01, ERA5 via ARCO, sst_update=1 so wrflowinp_d01 is an input file. Registered 2026-10-02 for the long-case end-to-end WTune test; first run was job 2016 (1 node, 64 ranks, 0.0688 s/step, 2:48:37). iofields_d01.txt is listed because WRF hangs at input_input when the namelist's iofields_filename is missing, even with ignore_iofields_warning=.true. (probe jobs 2541-2545, 2026-10-02).
